liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Eleven** (5 reviews, 1 other source): The performance of The Eleven is described as unreal; The Eleven starts slower then accelerates rapidly, featuring two enormous peaks [2][3][7][8][12][13]
- **Alligator** (2 reviews): The transition from Alligator to Caution is the show's real centerpiece; The Alligator performance is beautiful with a big, fat finish [4][13]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The version of Dark Star sounds experimental, though little is recorded [5]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): The reviewer highlights the performance of Saint Stephen [5]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop on Tracks)** (1 review): The rendition of Caution is considered fantastic [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **William Tell**: rare: 9 archived performances [15]
- **Drummers' Chant**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [15]
- **Alligator Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd69-02-12.late.sbd.kaplan.9072.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 69 min; rated 4.56/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is superb, though some material at the start is missing; Sound quality is superb, despite a missing chunk of Dark Star; Track 7 is noted as the crunchiest among the tracks [3][4][11]
- **gd1969-02-12.sbd-late.cotsman.6285.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 57 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [2]

## Around the show

- Jerry and Dupree are in prime connection with high-end harmonies [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-02-12.late.sbd.kaplan.9072.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Found at Best Buy around 1999, remastered and complete, possibly pre-Dick's Picks; Missing Alligator Jam segment patched from alternate SBD source, one cassette gen [1][8]
- **gd1969-02-12.sbd-late.cotsman.6285.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jeff Cotsman, Jeff Cook; source: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1969-02-11 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1969-02-11-11/) [16]
